newsitem.title: CONGO: Banyamulenge Tutsis flee to Congo from Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Banyamulenge Tutsis flee to Congo from Kinshasa.

text.p: Around 50 Banyamulenge Tutsis from Zaire have fled the capital Kinshasa and taken refuge in neighbouring Congo, fearing reprisals for a Tutsi revolt in the east, one of the refugees said.
"We were obliged to flee reprisals from the people in Kinshasa," the refugee, who asked to remain anonymous, told Reuters in Congo's capital Brazzaville.

Fighting between Banyamulenge rebels and soldiers in eastern Zaire has put hundreds of thousands of Hutus from Rwanda and Burundi and Zairean civilians to flight and threatens to spark a border war between Tutsi-led Rwanda and Zaire.

The refugee said Banyamulenge, who migrated from Rwanda 200 years ago and claim Zairean citizenship, had become targets of pillaging in Kinshasa -- which is just across the Zaire River from Brazzaville.
Zaire's government accuses Rwanda of sending troops into its territory to fight alongside the Banyamulenge.
